import asyncio

class Operation:
    def __init__(self, resource):
        self.resource = resource
        self.state = "idle"
        self.started = asyncio.Event()
        self.release = asyncio.Event()
    async def run(self):
        self.state = "running"
        self.started.set()
        try:
            await self.release.wait()
        finally:
            await self.resource.close()
            self.state = "idle"

import asyncio
import unittest
from operation import Operation

class CancelTests(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    async def test_cancel(self):
        class Resource:
            count = 0
            async def close(self):
                self.count += 1
        resource = Resource()
        operation = Operation(resource)
        task = asyncio.create_task(operation.run())
        await operation.started.wait()
        task.cancel()
        with self.assertRaises(asyncio.CancelledError):
            await task
        self.assertEqual(resource.count, 1)
        self.assertEqual(operation.state, "idle")
    async def test_normal(self):
        class Resource:
            count = 0
            async def close(self):
                self.count += 1
        resource = Resource()
        operation = Operation(resource)
        task = asyncio.create_task(operation.run())
        await operation.started.wait()
        operation.release.set()
        await task
        self.assertEqual(resource.count, 1)
        self.assertEqual(operation.state, "idle")
